summary: The agent completed a substantial implementation, but both baseline and new suites failed before test execution because the modified annotation processor threw an AssertionError while generating a value with a nullable String attribute. This processor-wide crash prevented generated immutable classes from being produced and regressed all existing value-fixture tests.
quick_failure_summary: Annotation processing aborts on a nullable String attribute, so value-fixture cannot compile and no tests execute.

details.reasoning: The failure originates directly in agent-modified code: ValueType.isBinaryAttributeSupported accepts scalar attributes before checking nullability, then the generated-template path calls ValueAttribute.binaryScalarCodec with the annotated type string `java.lang.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable String`. binaryScalarCodec does not recognize that representation and throws AssertionError at ValueAttribute.java:1129. Annotation processing then stops globally, leaving many pre-existing Immutable* classes ungenerated. Because all 326 baseline tests fail from this regression in the modified processor, FAIL_REGRESSION is the dominant verdict even though the same defect also violates the explicit requirement that unsupported shapes receive neither method and not block unrelated eligible values.
details.secondary_factors: The agent validated only the serial reactor and its own focused fixtures. The trajectory reports `./mvnw -pl serial -am clean test` passing, but it did not run the broader value-fixture compilation that exposed the processor crash.

problem_assessment.notes: The task is broad and technically demanding but solvable, as demonstrated by the reference solution. The prompt explicitly requires unsupported shapes to disable the binary form without preventing unrelated eligible values from generation. The nullable hidden test permits either support or graceful disabling, so it does not impose an unfair nullable-specific behavior.

evidence: JUnit reports show 326/326 baseline failures and 38/38 new-test failures because Maven failed before Surefire reports were produced.
The test log contains `java.lang.AssertionError: java.lang.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable String` at the agent-modified `ValueAttribute.binaryScalarCodec(ValueAttribute.java:1129)`.
The ensuing missing Immutable* symbols are downstream consequences of the annotation processor aborting, not bootstrap, dependency, permission, or runtime failures.
The trajectory shows the agent successfully ran `./mvnw -pl serial -am clean test`; no external failure blocked implementation, though this narrower validation scope missed value-fixture coverage.
Early permission warnings came from an overly broad filesystem `find` and did not prevent repository inspection, editing, building, or targeted testing.
environment_assessment.finding: No meaningful external blocker was found; an agent-introduced annotation-processor assertion aborts fixture compilation.
